name: verify-dependency-exists
description: Allowlist gate for new dependencies; no registry lookup. Reads Python, Node, Rust, Ruby, PHP, JVM, .NET, Go, Elixir, Dart and Swift manifests (read, never run); blocks an added name missing from .chock/dependency-allowlist.txt, asks on a lockfile-only one. Not read: computed lists, sources, versions, some forms (see docs). No allowlist file (plugin-only installs): a manifest change warns, never blocks. Repo form is opt-in: seed, observe, `chock enable`. Runs: commit, agent write, turn's end. [Session-enforced via PreToolUse and Stop hooks; needs git and a Python 3.11+. PreToolUse judges the file a tool call would write; Stop re-reads what the turn actually left on disk, so a file written through a shell heredoc is judged too. With no working Python the hook exits 2; without git, fail-open clients allow silently. A gate that cannot reach a decision refuses rather than allowing one it never judged. Enforcement at every commit and in CI still needs chock installed in the repo.]
